text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-15T03:12Z -> started. routing tag=canary-2026-03-15 :rocket:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 incident created INC-2026-301 (canary latency spike). Paging oncall: @elaine :rotating_light:
elaine: I'm on it. seeing elevated p95 on canary nodes, autoscaler trending OK but latency jump to ~1200ms p95. What percentage of traffic is on the canary?
raj: Traffic tagging shows ~6% of production routed to canary via header-based routing. 2k requests/min. Error rate up small but latency huge for short bursts.
sam: Any recent infra changes? kernel or runtime flags?
carol: No infra deploys. This was a model rollout (quantized variant) and a config tweak to batching heuristics pushed with that release.
elaine: Reproduce locally? Trying quick smoke against a canary box: ```bash
curl -sS -w "time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null "https://canary-host.internal/api/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
elaine: Getting ~0.9s locally which is similar. Might be an interaction between quantized kernel and long tail tokens.
raj: Deploy-bot, can we short-circuit traffic to fallback model variant (stable-quant-off) for canary only? Need graceful fallback, not full rollback yet.
deploy-bot: Can flip routing rule: set header tag -> stable variant. Run `deployctl routing set --tag canary-2026-03-15 --target stable-variant --reason "latency spike"`. Confirm to proceed? :white_check_mark::x:
sam: I'm +1 to flip routing to stable variant for the canary group to reduce customer impact while we debug. This keeps the release in prod but removes perf regression.
elaine: Do it. raj, can you run the command and watch for cascade? Also start the rollback playbook in parallel in case we need full revert.
raj: Running now: ```
deployctl routing set --tag canary-2026-03-15 --target stable-variant --reason "latency spike"
```
deploy-bot: Routing update accepted. Old routing cached for 60s, full propagation ~120s.
elaine: Monitoring p95... 30s... 60s... p95 dropped to 280ms now. Traffic to canaries has been redirected. Errors stable. :thumbsup:
carol: Good signal. We still need to validate model quality impact. Please run quick evals on sampled traces vs golden set.
sam: I'll run a batch of 200 sample prompts through canary traffic replay to check semantic drift. ETA 7m.
incident-bot: Adding note to INC-2026-301: Traffic-tagged fallback applied; customer-impact reduced from high-latency to degraded, no increase in 5xx.
elaine: Oncall handoff plan: I'm going to stabilize and hand off to @tara for the night run. @tara, you'll have a checklist: 1) keep routing on stable-variant for canary tag, 2) run hourly evals for 6 hours, 3) escalate if p95 > 500ms or 5xx > 0.5%.
tara: Ack. Can you paste the rollback snapshot if we need to fully revert the rollout?
raj: Snapshot: `canary-release-id=release-2026-03-15-qtz-1`, rollback command: ```bash
releasectl rollback --id release-2026-03-15-qtz-1 --mode manual --notify "incident INC-2026-301"
```
Plus DB config restore is not needed for this release. Full rollback would remove release from model catalog and drain pods.
elaine: Also note smoke tests to run after rollback: ```bash
# quick smoke
curl -fsS "https://api.prod/internal/healthz" && \
curl -sS -H "X-Feature-Tag: canary-2026-03-15" "https://api.prod/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | head -n 1
```
carol: Customer impact summary for INC-2026-301: ~6% traffic saw p95 jump to ~1200ms for ~15 minutes; no large increase in error codes; few timeouts reported by one alpha customer (tenant-id: T-809). Ops estimate: impact reduced to negligible after routing flip.
elaine: Will add postmortem notes: suspected cause = quantized kernel tail-path for certain token sequences + recent batching heuristic. Next steps: 1) reproduce with longer token sequences locally, 2) add telemetry on kernel path selection, 3) roll forward a patched quantized binary behind feature flag.
tara: I'll take primary for the night. @elaine leaving summary and key runbook steps in the incident doc. If anything regresses ping me @tara or call.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-301 status -> mitigated. Severity -> downgraded to SEV-3. Owner -> tara. Timeline written to incident ticket.
elaine: handing off now. Leaving log pointers: `elk#/app/logs?query=canary-2026-03-15` and the sample trace IDs: [trace:abc123, trace:def456]. Good job team. :clap:
tara: Taking it. I'll run periodic evals and confirm tomorrow morning during the follow-up. Thanks all.
